utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the issue with the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm struggling to get it working. It's been a tough few weeks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need a hand troubleshooting it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Is the repair drive scheduled for a time when the streets aren't too crowded?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it's scheduled for a quiet time? I haven't heard anything about that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I really think we should double-check the schedule to avoid any issues with traffic.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but I can't quite remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I remember something about fixing up the playground, but don't ask me who's organizing it—I'd have to check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, the playground... I think I saw a sign about it a while back, but I'm fuzzy on the details too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Ira, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I hadn't heard about that. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a community event where people bring broken items and we fix them together. I'm planning to bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, what's this about a repair drive? I heard something about it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, it's a community thing where we fix up broken items instead of throwing them away. I'm lending out my tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds great, Gus! I've got a broken blender I've been meaning to fix. When's the next repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Quinn. I heard we're organizing a repair drive. Do we have a schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Morning, Eli! I heard it's this Saturday at 10 AM, but let me double-check with Sarah to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I appreciate you confirming. I do like to have things settled ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's to help neighbors fix up their broken appliances and things around the house.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds useful. How do we get involved?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Opal, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules! I've been keeping tabs on it—looks like the crew is working on the northwest corner now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! Need any extra hands out there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa, I'm so glad you're here. I've been thinking about the repair drive—what can I do to help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Mara, I'm so glad you asked! We could really use someone to help sort and inventory the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can absolutely do that—when should I start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Bo, what kind of supplies do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, just some basic tools. I grabbed a hammer and nails.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it. Do you need any tape or screws? I have extras.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I was thinking of bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I didn't know about that. I have a broken lamp I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, we can go together! I think they'll have tools to fix lamps too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What's this about a repair drive? Can you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's a community event where we fix up broken items instead of throwing them away. I'm helping organize it around school hours.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds interesting. What kind of items are people bringing, and where exactly is it being held?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm listening. What about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they might need more volunteers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday? I might have some time. What time do they need people?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, did you hear about the repair drive we're planning for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard! Sounds like a great way to get the neighborhood together. Need any help spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely! The more people we tell, the better. We're meeting at 10 AM in the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I was just thinking about something else... what's that about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community effort to fix up the old playground equipment. We're collecting tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the playground... I think I saw a notice about that. Count me in for Saturday, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Have you seen the repair drive around here lately?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I saw it over at the Johnson's last week. Need a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just wondering if they fixed that leak at the park yet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Opal! I'm glad to see you. Have you heard about the upcoming repair drive we're organizing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I heard something about it. Where exactly is it going to be held?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It'll be at the community center on Saturday from 9 to 3. We could really use your help if you're free!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough tools and volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I think we can get more folks; I'll head to the park and rally some volunteers!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good start, but we still need a proper list of tools. Can you check with the hardware store too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll wait for your confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Dane. Are we still on schedule for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Eli. Yeah, I think so—though I might be a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A bit late? Can we set a firm time so I can plan my morning?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard a bit about it from others. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's where folks bring broken items and we try to fix 'em with donated parts and tools. I've been logging what supplies we've got.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful! Do you need any help sorting through the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sorry, what repair drive are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The neighborhood tool repair drive we're organizing next Saturday—where folks bring their broken tools and we fix 'em up together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right! That sounds great. I’ll see if I can dig out my old rusty saw to bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo! Are you planning to help out with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. What time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're starting at 9 AM on Saturday at the community center. Hope you can make it!
